title: ムーンライトシンドローム
sources: RAM snapshot from Genkan (inbox): the line on screen found as 16-bit codes by its pattern of repeated characters; the kana fit the gojuon order exactly, and the surrounding dialogue decodes as Japanese
The same bytes are on disc in PROLOGUE.DAT, archive entry 0 (the prologue script), uncompressed
notes: Kana are mapped (tables/human-kana.tbl). Codes are 2 bytes, high byte first, and in this RAM buffer they start at an odd address. Kanji are 0x0100 up in the order of the scene's own font (早 0x0104, 帰 0x0105 in the prologue), so they likely change between scenes: read them from the font or by OCR. 0xFFF9-0xFFFF are control codes, some followed by a parameter word (FFFA xx, FFF9 xxxx); their meanings aren't mapped yet.
